description: This file defines an LDAP driver class for the ADOdb database abstraction library, implementing read-only LDAP database access, including connection handling, search, and retrieval operations.

classes.name: ADODB_ldap
classes.description: LDAP driver class for ADOdb providing connection, search, and configuration functionalities.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ldap
classes.description: RecordSet class for handling LDAP query results, providing methods to fetch and process LDAP entries.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes an LDAP connection using specified host, credentials, and base DN.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Performs an LDAP search with a given filter string.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last LDAP connection error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last LDAP error number.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Sets the LDAP base DN for searches.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP server configuration and status information.
